security_audit.summary: The critical pipe-to-shell installer on SKILL.md line 16 is confirmed and should block automatic publication until removed. Most external command alerts are Markdown formatting false positives, while the remaining confirmed issues reflect outbound HTTP examples and third-party Python execution.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl pipe-to-shell instructions with a manual download, checksum verification, and a separate install command.

remediation.issue: User Python code is executed by a third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear warnings to avoid secrets and document isolation, retention, and network egress controls.
State that users must follow site policies and avoid sending credentials or private data to external endpoints.

content.user_title: Run Python Code in a Managed Sandbox
content.value_statement: Python tasks often need libraries and isolated execution. This skill runs Python through inference.sh with tools for data, media, scraping, and automation.
actual_capabilities: Runs Python 3.10 code through the infsh/python-executor app.
Supports configurable timeouts from 1 to 300 seconds.
Uses libraries for HTTP, scraping, data analysis, images, video, audio, 3D files, and PDFs.
Returns files saved in the outputs directory.
Offers default 8GB RAM and high-memory 16GB variants.
Captures printed output and generated artifacts for the user.
limitations: Requires the infsh CLI, an inference.sh account, and network access.
Runs CPU-only and does not provide GPU machine learning libraries.
Non-interactive code must save plots or files instead of opening windows.
User code and input data are sent to a third-party execution service.

use_cases.title: Analyze Business Data
use_cases.description: Load datasets, compute summaries, and generate charts or exported files for review.

use_cases.title: Automate Python Workflows
use_cases.description: Run repeatable scripts for API checks, file conversion, and small automation jobs.

use_cases.title: Create Media and Documents
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, PDFs, and 3D assets using pre-installed Python libraries.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Script
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of the executor environment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a Python script that prints the current pandas version. Use the default timeout and capture the result.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate data analysis with a generated chart.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Python to inspect the uploaded sales data, summarize the columns, and create a chart saved in the outputs directory.

prompt_templates.title: Process Media Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced file processing with generated artifacts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Python libraries to resize the provided images, create thumbnails, and return the processed files with a short summary.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Step Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with network access and generated reports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a Python workflow that fetches approved API data, validates the response, creates a report, and returns generated files.

output_examples.input: A request to inspect a small sales dataset and produce a bar chart.
output_examples.output: Returns column summaries, total sales by person, and a chart file saved for download.

output_examples.input: A request to resize uploaded images for a product catalog.
output_examples.output: Returns resized image files, dimensions, and a short processing log.

output_examples.input: A request to call an approved public API and create a PDF summary.
output_examples.output: Returns a concise data summary, API status details, and the generated PDF report.

best_practices: Review Python code for secrets, file paths, and external requests before execution.
Set the shortest practical timeout and choose high memory only for large workloads.
Save artifacts in the outputs directory so they are returned reliably.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote install scripts directly into a shell.
Do not send private keys, tokens, customer data, or regulated data to the executor.
Do not use the skill for stealth scraping, abuse, or unauthorized network access.

faq.question: Does this run code locally?
faq.answer: No. The skill runs Python through the inference.sh app, not directly inside the agent workspace.

faq.question: Which tools are required?
faq.answer: It uses the infsh CLI and the configured Bash permission for infsh commands.

faq.question: Can it access the internet?
faq.answer: Examples show HTTP requests for web scraping and APIs. Treat all outbound requests as external network activity.

faq.question: How do I get generated files?
faq.answer: Save files in the outputs directory. The skill documentation says these files are automatically returned.

faq.question: Can it use GPU libraries?
faq.answer: No. The documented environment is CPU-only and directs AI workloads to dedicated apps.

faq.question: Is it safe for secrets?
faq.answer: No. Avoid secrets or sensitive data because code and inputs may be processed by an external execution service.
